veranderings.voor: Verf gaan as 'n vloeistof op 'n muur of 'n hek aan.
veranderings.na: Verf word as 'n vloeistof op 'n muur of 'n hek aangebring.
veranderings.rede: 'aangaan' means to continue or to switch on, so 'gaan op 'n muur aan' is unidiomatic; paint is 'aangebring'.
AWS: a comma separates two coordinate adjectives before a noun.

vlae.teks: soos hard en sag, sterk en swak, lig en swaar, en waterdig
vlae.rede: This is a list with a comma before its final 'en', which the house rule never allows in a list; but the items are themselves pairs joined by 'en', so taking the comma out gives 'lig en swaar en waterdig' and blurs the pairs. I left it alone for the reviewer to decide.

vlae.teks: Tekstuur is hoe 'n oppervlak voel as jy dit aanraak, soos glad of grof.
vlae.rede: This sentence in the study text defines tekstuur more narrowly than the prescribed glossary wording, which adds 'of hoe dit lyk asof dit sou voel'. That is a content matter, not a language one, so I made no change; noted in case the two are meant to match.
